name: Debbie Care
story: Dr Debbie Care founded AgVice and used GIS as part of farm-environment planning and catchment work. Eagle documents AgVice using ArcGIS, drones, StoryMaps, Experience Builder and digital farm plans in the Wai Kōkopu programme, and the company won the 2023 New Zealand Esri StoryMaps competition. Care had earlier presented GIS and drone use for farm-environment work at the 2019 user conference.
